message.reasoning:
We need to fix code causing OutOfMemoryError. Likely infinite loop in test axfrIteratorReturnsAllRRsetsInOrder: they create iterator inside Stream.generate each time new iterator -> infinite loop? Actually they generate stream that repeatedly creates new iterator each time, leading to infinite because iterator always has elements, never ends. Should instead get iterator once and iterate. So test is flawed. We need to adjust test code to avoid OOM. Also other tests may have similar pattern: they use Stream.generate with iterator each time; but they create new iterator each iteration, causing infinite loop. For axfrIteratorReturnsAllRRsetsInOrder they do:

List<RRset> normalList = Stream.generate(() -> {
            Iterator<RRset> it = ZONE.iterator();
            if (it.hasNext()) {
                return it.next();
            }
            return null;
        }).takeWhile(Objects::nonNull).collect...

This also creates new iterator each time, infinite. Should instead use ZONE.iterator() once.

Similarly in other tests they use Stream.generate correctly (they keep same iterator). So only these two need fixing.

Also in axfrWithMultipleRRsetsOrdering expected list seems mismatched: they list "NS" for mx? Should be "MX". The expected list currently: "SOA","NS","NS","NS","NS","MX","AAAA","A","SOA"? Actually they wrote:

List<String> expected = List.of(// apex SOA
        "SOA", // NS1
        "NS", // NS2
        "NS", // nsExtra (c.example.)
        "NS", // mx (a.example.)
        "MX", // aAAA (a.example.)
        "AAAA", // aB (b.example.)
        "A", // closing SOA
        "SOA");

Seems wrong order and types. Should be: SOA, NS (apex NS1), NS (apex NS2), NS (c.example.), MX (a.example.), AAAA (a.example.), A (b.example.), SOA (closing). That's 8 elements. So expected list should be ["SOA","NS","NS","NS","MX","AAAA","A","SOA"]; not include extra NS for mx. And order after MX then AAAA then A.

Thus test will fail. We'll correct expected list.

Also test axfrIteratorTypeAndUnsupportedRemove expects class name contains "ZoneIterator". Might be different; but we can keep.

Also test axfrIteratorIllegalStateAfterExhaustion expects IllegalStateException or NoSuchElementException. fine.

Thus modify test class accordingly.

Potential other issues: In setupBeforeEach they reassign ZONE_NAME after creating ZONE; fine.

Also imports: they import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListMap; used.

Now adjust code.
